title: Realtime messaging
goal: Launch tenant-safe realtime messaging with membership enforcement, reconnect behavior, typing, presence, and durable read state
acceptance_criteria: Every conversation read, send, topic, presence, typing, and read-state operation enforces membership at the server or database boundary
Cross-user and cross-tenant access attempts fail without leaking conversation identifiers or metadata
Reconnect, duplicate delivery, offline recovery, unread and read-state behavior are deterministic
Two-user deployed staging validation and focused Realtime/RLS suites pass
